changelog.message: op created for native Node N-API-backed Apple Vision hand pose landmarks tracker
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Tracks 2D human hand joints, fingers, and chirality (left/right) in real-time from an input WebGL texture using macOS Apple Vision neural frameworks directly in memory.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Starts or stops the native HumanHand tracking engine.

ports.name: Render
ports.text: Trigger render loop to process the incoming texture.

ports.name: Texture
ports.text: WebGL Texture containing the hand subject to track.

ports.name: Hands Array
ports.text: An array of detected hands containing tracked finger joints, wrist, normalized coordinates (top-left mapped), hand chirality (left/right), and confidence levels.

ports.name: Detected Hands
ports.text: Total number of hands currently tracked in the active frame.

ports.name: On Hands Detected
ports.text: Trigger fired every time a new set of hand landmarks is received.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native hand tracking engine is active.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the tracking engine.
